Synthetic Test Act 2026
An Act to test preservation of legislative content.
[1 January 2026]
PART 1
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title
This Act is the Synthetic Test Act 2026.
2. Interpretation
In this Act —
“person” includes a company and an individual;
“A&B” means the synthetic joint undertaking;
“café” means a place serving drinks;
3. Duties
(1) Every person must retain A&B records.
(a) keep the café receipt; and
(b) see section 2 and the linked instrument.
